svg.title: SafeStitch — Inspector user flow (17 screens; admin-only areas and first-admin setup removed)

text.tspan: SafeStitch — Inspector user flow (17 screens; admin-only areas and first-admin setup removed)

Kotlin · Jetpack Compose (Material 3) · type-safe Navigation-Compose: 21 routes in one NavHost + 3 auth states in MainActivity · Room/SQLite · CameraX + ZXing · PDF (PdfDocument + PDFBox) · offline-first with optional WorkManager sync · roles: Admin, Inspector

ROLE VIEW — INSPECTOR: 17 screens · 16 pop-ups/menus · 7 Android/system hand-offs · 170 traced transitions (142 navigation / back / pop-up / dialog-outcome / hand-off + 28 in-screen state changes) · 72 confirmed on the emulator · source commit d797895 · generated 2026-11-15
EQUIPMENT · SCAN · INSPECTION · REPORT & PDF — detail: 04, 05

Home · Inspect · Actions · History switch to each other from these four screens (popUpTo Home, saveState/restoreState). ⚠ Bug: a tab screen opened from a Home KPI card or 'Find equipment' is restored by the Home tab instead of the dashboard (System Back fixes it).

D01 Account menu | Source: ui/dashboard/DashboardScreen.kt | Roles: Admin, Inspector

text.tspan: INSPECTOR: the 'Admin tools' item is not rendered (if (user.isAdmin))
Return after save / photo (popBackStack to the opener)
← / system Back → previous screen on the stack
Opens a pop-up / menu / permission prompt
Hands off to Android / another app / server
✓ in an arrow label, or '✓ RUN' on a screen = exercised in the Android 16 emulator walkthrough; everything else is traced in source.
ADMIN dashed outline inside a frame = control rendered only when user.isAdmin. Dashed tray under a frame = that screen's pop-ups and hand-offs.
Every screen with ← (and the system Back gesture) returns to the previous screen via NavController.popBackStack(); only non-obvious returns are drawn.
Role view: admin-only screens, arrows and controls are removed; red notes mark where an inspector is stopped.
• Inspectors never see: Account menu › Admin tools, Inspect + / Edit / print-labels, S15 'Verify & close', 'Not fixed: send back' and the admin
• Inspectors CAN: inspect, photograph, submit, start/resolve corrective actions, browse history and captured photos, use Settings and the
Safety Assistant, and register new equipment by scanning an unknown code.
• Admin routes have no NavHost guard; an inspector simply has no UI entry point to them.

g.title: UI visibility vs data-layer enforcement, from the source

text.tspan: ACCESS CONTROL — intended (UI) vs enforced (data layer)
No NavHost route has a guard; ✗ = the action relies on the UI hiding it (an access-control concern).
Add / edit equipment via + / Edit (S04 → S10)
Register equipment by scanning an unknown code
none — Scan › unknown code, any role
Verify / send back / reassign / reschedule action (S15)
n/a — any signed-in user by design
